Mirrors task add pattern.

rawActions.name: Action.statusDate
rawActions.summary: statusDate:Date field on Action. Constructor: new Date(). Serialized as string in Avro (type:'string',default:''). Schema.#convertDates() handles Date→ISO at toAvro() boundary. patch() sets statusDate=new Date() when status changes, preserves it otherwise. No legacy handling needed.
rawActions.statusNote: statusDate:Date in memory, ISO string in Avro via toAvro() Date conversion, updated on status change; 53 tests pass

rawActions.name: Improve action add command
rawActions.summary: Change action add to positional args: action add <name> [summary]. Mirrors ref add and task add patterns. Default relevance 0.5 if applicable.

rawActions.name: Schema.toBuffer/fromBuffer
rawActions.summary: Add schema.toBuffer(jsObj, opts) and schema.fromBuffer(buf, EntityClass, opts) to encapsulate the toAvro→toBuffer and fromBuffer→new Entity steps. Reduces 4-step avro round-trip to 2 calls.

rawActions.name: Display statusDate in action status
rawActions.summary: Append ActionStats.shortDate(statusDate) to action status in tuiRowStrings. Create src/action-stats.ts with static ActionStats class. shortDate(date) algorithm: (1) if date is today, return Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined,{timeStyle:'short'}).format(date) — locale-aware, respects 24h; (2) else fmt=Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined,{dateStyle:'short'}); compare fmt(date) vs fmt(new Date(year+4,month,day)); find contiguous spans of differing chars; if exactly 1 span, extend through adjacent digits and separators, strip result; else return full s. In tuiRowStrings: insert shortDate between coloredStatus and row items. Export ActionStats from src/index.ts. Tests in test/action-stats.ts: today→time string; past year→no-year string; leap day→no-year string.
